# Pixel Operator

Raster 90 retains the four unmodified Pixel Operator font files under
`fonts/` as provenance and design references; they are not packaged in the
production watch-face bundle:

- `PixelOperatorMono.ttf`
- `PixelOperatorMonoHB.ttf`
- `PixelOperatorMono8.ttf`
- `PixelOperatorMonoHB8.ttf`

Source: <https://www.dafont.com/pixel-operator.font>

The downloaded archive identifies the work as CC0 1.0 Universal. See
`LICENSE.txt`. These files are calibration inputs, not production resources.
V1 uses project-owned deterministic matrices under `design/raster90/`,
generated by `tools/generate_raster90_assets.py`; Pixel Operator remains the
CC0 starting point for future bitmap-shape review.
